component.name: Earshot
component.summary: Find, follow and listen to podcasts

description.p: Earshot is a podcast app made for Luma. Find shows in the charts or by searching, follow the ones you like, and their new episodes are waiting for you. It fits a computer, a tablet, a phone and a TV, and keeps playing with the window closed.

ul.li: Discover: charts for 15 categories, and search across the whole podcast directory
New episodes from every show you follow in one place, and Keep listening for what you started
Up next: line up what to play, and it plays through on its own
Speed from 0.8× to 3× without chipmunk voices, remembered for each show
Chapters, and times in the show notes you can tap to jump straight there
A sleep timer that fades out gently, or stops at the end of the episode or chapter
Download episodes to listen without a connection; finished downloads clean themselves up
Media keys, headphone buttons and the lock screen control playback
Bring your shows from any other podcast app with OPML, and take them anywhere

description.p: Earshot is free, with no ads. Earshot Plus is an optional purchase (a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time unlock, paid through Stripe) that adds voice boost, skipping intros and outros, automatic downloads and listening stats. Everything above stays free.
There is no account and no tracking. Earshot talks only to the shows you follow and, when you search or browse the charts, to the Apple Podcasts directory.
